name: shift-2026-11-19-14-27 — ProjectManager shift 8 report (commit not executable: no shell in the runtime; node gate dropped, human hand-over raised)
description:
# TL; DR;

**In plain terms:** we finally hit the wall that was always there. Not "the tests are hard" — **no agent in this environment can run `git` at all**. So the commit that has been planned for four shifts cannot be made by me or by any colleague; it needs a human with a terminal, or a different container image.

**Status: at risk — one hard stop, and it is a human hand-over, not more analysis.**

- **Today's finding (the important one):** "no Node so tests cannot run" and "cannot commit" are **the same defect**. The agent container has **no shell**. The very same missing thing that makes tests impossible also makes the commit impossible. Fixing it once unblocks **both**, and it also unblocks every future verification on this board.
- **What I did with it:** the card instructed me to post one line and stop if git cannot run. I did exactly that — `commit not executable: no shell/exec tool and no HEAD-write tool in this runtime` — and put the **complete copy-paste command block** on the card. Any human can now finish this in about 40 seconds.
- **What I refused to do:** fake it. There is a tool that commits to a *new branch* — I could have produced something that looks like a commit, on a branch nobody asked for, leaving `main` unchanged. That would have "passed" the shift and broken the release. I did not use it.
- **Unchanged, verified just now:** `main` is still `dba24f4` — no commit landed. The 3 efforts files are still ready (+19/−9) and `package.json` is still dirty with the **dependency downgrade** that must not go in.

**What management must decide:** who runs the 4 commands. Recommend a human operator today; waiting for a new container image slips the increment to Monday. Card `53ed97fc` at **11-20 16:00Z** is where the "ship without executed tests" risk gets formally accepted.

---

## 1. Summary
The efforts increment is code-complete and scoped to 3 paths, but **cannot be committed by any agent in this runtime** because the agent container has no exec. I converted that from a vague recurring blocker into a precise, hand-over-ready package: evidence of why, the exact commands, the acceptance criteria, and the one command that proves the scope held. Business outcome: the increment is now **40 seconds of human work** away from being releasable, instead of an open-ended "still blocked".

## 2. Scope
- **In:** `0bc8b144` (the commit), `a0f362ed` (test run, de-gated), `91411767` (node/runtime), `53ed97fc` (accept residual risk).
- **Out:** `79a1336d`, `94d15daf`, `8a554fa4`, `b19676fe`, `3a86fba9` (platform/tooling, not fixable in this repo) · `675c4695` and `f949754f` (recurrence feature — a different increment) · `61098a6b` (cleanup).

## 3. Increment plan

| Milestone | Deliverable | Owner | Date (UTC) | Deployable | Demoable | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| M1f | **Commit 3 paths, +19/−9** | **human operator** (`software_developer` has no shell) | 11-19 17:00 (re-armed) | yes — 3 files revert cleanly | `git show --stat HEAD` = 3 files | **onhold — escalated, hand-over block on card** |
| M1a | Exec-capable runtime (`git` + `node`) | devops `91411767` | 11-19 09:30 (stale wake) | n/a | `node --version` / `git --version` | doing — **root cause of both blockers** |
| M1c | Run `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` → 9 `ok -` | software_developer `a0f362ed` | 11-20 16:30 | n/a | 9 `ok -`, exit 0 | **onhold — no longer a precondition** |
| M1d | Test suite (9 cases in HEAD, +3/−5 pending) | software_developer `d4e3a041` | 11-20 16:30 | yes | with M1c | doing, 60 % |
| M1e | `EffortsSettings.remove()` fix (+8/−1, in tree) | software_developer `fcf65219` | 11-19 09:04 (stale wake) | yes | delete a built-in → visible 409 | doing — static review only |

## 4. Dependencies & critical path
`91411767` (exec-capable runtime) → `0bc8b144` (commit) → `f48294e8` (independent verification) → `53ed97fc` (go/no-go 11-20 16:00Z).

**The critical path moved off "node" and onto "a runtime with a shell".** That is a smaller, cheaper ask with a larger payoff: it serves the commit, the tests and every future QA gate. `a0f362ed` was **removed** from the commit's preconditions this shift — it was a gate nobody could satisfy, which is a deadlock, not a quality bar.

## 5. Risks

| Risk | Impact | Prob. | Mitigation | Owner | Decision? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R13 **new** — no exec in the agent runtime: no agent can commit or test | increment frozen for a 4th shift | **certain** (measured) | human hand-over block on `0bc8b144`; runtime fix `91411767` | devops | **yes (D6)** |
| R1 no Node runtime | tests never executed, DoD "tests green" unmet | high | residual risk accepted at `53ed97fc` | PM | D3 |
| R14 **new** — unverified behaviour change ships | a regression reaches `main` unproven | medium | 3-file revertible commit; static review cross-checked line by line; demo-provable without Node | PM | **yes (D7)** |
| R5 one 65+ file commit | increment not demoable/revertible | low now | pathspec commit mandatory; index holds 102 `.codx` entries | PM | D5 (closed) |
| R12 stale card descriptions (recurrence) | owner follows a wrong instruction | medium | `a0f362ed` body still says "8 `ok -`" and `node tests/…` — correction is in its comments only | PM | no |
| R4 HIGH hidden comment ships | security finding released | low | out of this commit by pathspec; owned by `675c4695` / `f949754f` | PM | D4 |

## 6. Decisions needed from management
1. **D6 — who executes the commit.** (a) a human with a terminal, today, using the block on `0bc8b144`; (b) wait for an exec-capable runner image (`91411767`); (c) commit nothing and re-plan M1. **Recommend (a)** — 40 seconds of work, zero risk to the index because the pathspec is explicit. Decide by **11-19 17:00Z**.
2. **D7 — accept "ship without executed tests".** (a) accept, with the 3-file revert as the safety net and a demo that needs no Node; (b) hold the commit until 9 `ok -` lines exist. **Recommend (a)** — the fix is 19 lines, statically cross-checked, and independently revertible. Decide by **11-20 16:00Z** at `53ed97fc`.
3. **D3 — demo slot.** Thursday if D6 resolves 11-19, otherwise Monday 11-23. **Recommend keeping it a switch.** Decide by **11-19 17:00Z**.

## 7. Next checkpoint & demo
- **11-19 17:00Z** — `0bc8b144` re-arms with the hand-over block. If nobody has run it, it re-surfaces rather than silently dying.
- **11-20 16:00Z** — `53ed97fc`, the single go/no-go for M1.
- **11-20 16:30Z** — `a0f362ed` re-arms, re-scoped to "run it if a runtime now exists".
- To run the demo the team needs: a built-in effort, a delete confirmation, and one browser console. **No Node required** — the 409 must appear as a visible error and the effort must stay in the list.

## 8. Demo script (no Node needed)
1. Settings → Efforts → pick a **built-in** effort → Delete → confirm.
2. **Expect:** a visible error carrying the server's 409 message, and the effort still listed. Before the fix the UI went silent and implied success.
3. Delete a throwaway effort → it disappears and the list reloads.
4. Question for management: is the recurrence work (uncommitted, carrying a HIGH finding) in or out of the next increment?

---

## Shift report

**Status: at risk.** One cause, now precisely named: **no exec and no HEAD-write capability in this runtime.** Nothing else is blocking.

**Done (measured, this turn):**
- `project_changes(scope="all", paths=[3 paths + package.json])` vs HEAD → **4 files, +20/−10**; `package.json` still `+1/−1` (the `^2.0.3 → ^0.2.3` downgrade, still out of scope).
- `repository_overview()` → `main`, HEAD `dba24f4bf27c3b139ff4c8f890630ce090957f45`, `ahead: 6`, `dirty: true`, `locked: false`, `last_commits: []`. **Identical HEAD to the shift-6 measurement → still no commit.**
- Posted the required single line on `0bc8b144`: `commit not executable: no shell/exec tool and no HEAD-write tool in this runtime`, plus an evidence table of *why each available tool cannot do it* and a copy-paste hand-over block (`git add -- …`, `git commit -m … -- …`, `git show --stat`, `git diff HEAD -- package.json`), flagging that the trailing pathspec is what stops 102 staged `.codx/` entries from being swept in.
- `0bc8b144` → **onhold**, wake **11-19 17:00Z**, progress 50, high.
- `a0f362ed` → **onhold**, wake **11-20 16:30Z**, priority medium, progress 0 — and a comment withdrawing the hard-gate role I gave it in shift 5, so it no longer contradicts the commit card. Also corrected in writing: **9** cases (not 8), `node --test tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` **single file only** (never `node --test tests/`, which pulls 6 untracked voice suites), and the file is **tracked with only a +3/−5 delta** pending.

**Deliberately not done:** used no workaround. `create_pr_branch` was rejected in writing — it commits to a divergent branch, leaves `main` unchanged, and would have produced an artefact that looks like success while the increment stayed unshipped. `project_write_file` was rejected because the card forbids writing files and re-emitting a 631-line SFC from a read is precisely the corruption risk this card exists to prevent.

**Scheduled:** `0bc8b144` 11-19 17:00Z · `53ed97fc` 11-20 16:00Z (go/no-go) · `a0f362ed` 11-20 16:30Z · `f48294e8` 11-20 15:00Z (independent verification).

**Blocked:** `0bc8b144` and `91411767` — same root cause. The agent container has no shell, so `git` and `node` are both unreachable: `node --version` exit 126, `apt-get` exit 100 (non-root, dpkg lock). **No agent on this board can clear it.** It needs a human operator today (D6) or a new runner image.

**No repository files changed** — board state and card instructions only, which is correct for this role.
